description: Standardize QUOC_TICH via Danhmuc_QuocGia: map MA_QG/QUOC_GIA/abbr to TEN_QG/TEN_VT/full; keep original if not mapped
Standardize LOAI_GTTT via Danhmuc_Loai_GTTT: map old values (GTTT) to new standard (LOAI_GTTT); keep original if not mapped
Remove special characters from NOI_CAP_GTTT (keep letters and safe punctuation: _ -,.;)
If PASS_E_DT cannot be parsed as date MM/DD/YYYY, set to null (after V1 marks invalid dates)
Remove non-digits from MOBILE (and RES_PH_NO_1, RES_PH_NO_2 if present)
PASS_E_DT must be convertible to date MM/DD/YYYY (future dates or malformed are invalid)
MOBILE must contain only digits (no special characters)
Phone length/format: if starts with 0 then 10 digits; if starts with [35789] then 9 digits (after cleansing)
PASS_NO length depends on LOAI_GTTT: CCCD/THE CAN CUOC = 12 digits; CMTND/CMTQD = 9 or 12 digits
LOAI_GTTT must belong to allowed set per Danhmuc_Loai_GTTT (values not in the catalog are invalid)
For CCCD/THE CAN CUOC, PASS_E_DT must equal PASS_I_DT + 15 years
PASS_I_DT must be after D_O_B and not after CIF open date (if provided)
QUOC_TICH must not be in special-control list per Danhmuc_QuocGia where KIEM_SOAT = 1
Match on LOAI_GTTT and PASS_NO duplicates across core records
Match individuals on F_NAME, M_NAME, L_NAME, D_O_B, SEX_CD (CUSTOMER_TYPE=I)
Merge address: prefer CARD_ADDR when available, else CORE_CIF RES_ADD_1
Merge duplicates: prefer records without invalids; then lowest error count; then individual; then newest CIF
